note: Track M body template: what any horse subject is annotated with. Nothing here is specific to one reference: coverage, colours, crops and positions live in the subject config.

landmarks.ear_tip_a: tip of an ear (which ear is recorded in the subject's notes when it can be told)
landmarks.poll: top of the head between the ears
landmarks.bit_ring: centre of the bit ring at the mouth corner
landmarks.throat: where the jaw meets the neck underneath
landmarks.head_top: highest point of the head (when the poll can't be told)
landmarks.chest_front: front-most point of the chest or its armour
landmarks.withers: highest point of the back between the shoulders
landmarks.hind_near_hoof: near hind leg hoof, ground contact
landmarks.hind_far_hoof: far hind leg hoof, ground contact
landmarks.tail_top_visible: highest visible point of the tail hair
landmarks.tail_tip: lowest point of the tail hair
landmarks.chanfron_top: top corner of the head armour
landmarks.chanfron_nose_tip: lowest point of the head armour on the nose
landmarks.hem_front: lowest point of the caparison at the chest
landmarks.hem_side: lowest point of the caparison's side panel
landmarks.hem_belly: lowest point of the caparison under the belly
landmarks.hem_rear: lowest point of the caparison or skirt at the rear
landmarks.crupper_ornament: an ornament on the crupper strap over the tail

class_notes.chanfron: head armour (metal or gold inside the head zone)
class_notes.coat: the horse's own hair and skin (head, body)
class_notes.tail: tail hair inside the tail zone
class_notes.plume: a plume or tuft (red inside the plume zone)
class_notes.unclassified: no colour rule matched and no labelled pixel near: shown, not guessed
class_notes.excluded: inside a never_use region: invented or overruled pixels that later stages must not use
